title: On k-nearest-neighbor regression in metric spaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.41896v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study mean squared consistency of k-nearest-neighbor regression for metric space valued features. For a fixed feature distribution mu with atomless distance distributions, we describe how neighbor selection redistributes probability through the density of a uniformly chosen neighbor of an independent query. This gives separate conditions for the approximation error and the conditional response variance, and weakens Stone's domination condition when stronger response moments are available. In particular, when k_n tends to infinity and k_n/n tends to zero, a uniform L2(mu) bound on the selection densities suffices under a finite fourth response moment. We give a corresponding condition in terms of neighborhoods of fixed population mass and recover the Euclidean density bound. Finite global Nagata dimension gives Stone's domination. translated_title: 论度量空间中的k近邻回归
translated_abstract: 我们研究了特征取值于度量空间时k近邻回归的均方一致性。对于具有无原子距离分布的固定特征分布μ，我们描述了邻居选择如何通过独立查询点的均匀随机邻居的密度重新分配概率。由此我们分别给出了逼近误差和条件响应方差各自的条件，并在响应变量具有更强矩条件时弱化了Stone的控制条件。特别地，当k_n趋于无穷且k_n/n趋于零时，在选择密度满足一致L2(μ)界的条件下，响应变量只需具有有限四阶矩即可。我们还给出了基于固定总体质量邻域的相应条件，并恢复了欧几里得情形下的密度界。有限的全局Nagata维数可推出Stone的控制条件。虽然已知σ-有限的Nagata维数性可保证k-NN分类的普遍一致性……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文为特征取值于度量空间的k近邻回归建立了均方一致性条件，通过邻居选择密度的视角分别刻画逼近误差与条件响应方差，并在有限四阶响应矩下弱化了Stone的控制条件。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes mean squared consistency conditions for k-nearest-neighbor regression with metric-space-valued features, separately characterizing approximation error and conditional response variance through neighbor-selection densities and weakening Stone's domination condition under a finite fourth response moment.
